app.name: Review food-traceability evidence
app.description: Review which firms belong on a tracing inquiry list before deciding whom to investigate. Compare the product and business-role explanations permitted by the case, derive possible supply connections, and follow each product through the network. Explicitly supplied recall starting points can also be traced and compared. Catalog compatibility supports a modeled inquiry; it does not establish contamination, actual shipments or an issued recall.
app.source:
# Canonical evidence-review/1 model. Rules and presentation are data.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: food-traceability-evidence
  version: "1.3.0"
  title: Review food-traceability evidence
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: food-supply-chains
        label: Food supply chains
        description: Food production and distribution networks and their tracing relationships.
      useCase:
        id: traceability-inquiry
        label: Identify firms for a tracing inquiry
        description: Determine which firms belong on an inquiry list across permitted product and business-role explanations.
  description: "Review which firms belong on a tracing inquiry list before deciding whom to investigate. Compare the product and business-role explanations permitted by the case, derive possible supply connections, and follow each product through the network. Explicitly supplied recall starting points can also be traced and compared. Catalog compatibility supports a modeled inquiry; it does not establish contamination, actual shipments or an issued recall."
  question: "Which firms belong on this tracing inquiry list, and whose inclusion is still uncertain?"
  boundary: "The conclusions cover the submitted firm directory, catalogs, business roles, product transformations, permitted incident explanations and tracing assumptions. A potential supply connection is not an observed shipment or contamination finding. Seed geography limits inquiry starting points; report geography filters the completed trace. Unlisted firms, products, lots, intermediaries and catalog errors are outside the declared model. Inquiry findings do not issue a recall or authorize other action."
  assumptions: [Each possible incident explanation uses an active set of product and business-role hypotheses permitted by the case. The reviewer does not choose which explanation is true., The minimum and maximum numbers of active hypotheses are analytical premises supplied by the case., Potential supply connections preserve product identity between distinct firms with compatible roles and matching catalogs., A declared ingredient transformation changes products only within a processor handling both products., "Tracing retains firm–product identity and each stipulated recall origin. Reporting geography is applied after tracing and does not remove intermediate firms.", The derived inquiry list includes starting firms. Upstream and downstream reports exclude their own starting firms and count each firm or state once., Counts and catalog overlap supply no probability of contamination or permission to act.]
  parameters:
    - id: seedMode
      type: string
      enum: [hypothesis, stipulated]
      default: hypothesis
      label: How inquiry starting points are supplied
    - id: minActiveHypotheses
      type: integer
      min: 0
      max: 2
      default: 1
      label: Minimum simultaneous incident explanations
    - id: maxActiveHypotheses
      type: integer
      min: 0
      max: 2
      default: 1
      label: Maximum simultaneous incident explanations
    - id: targetFirm
      type: string
      default: F11
      label: Firm to review
    - id: reportRegion
      type: string
      default: Northeast
      label: Reporting region
  relations:
    - id: state
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: region
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: region
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: firm
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
        - id: state
          type: string
          references:
            relation: state
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: product
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: role
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: firmRole
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
          references:
            relation: firm
            column: id
        - id: role
          type: string
          references:
            relation: role
            column: id
      key: [firm, role]
    - id: catalog
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
          references:
            relation: firm
            column: id
        - id: product
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
      key: [firm, product]
    - id: roleFlow
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: from
          type: string
          references:
            relation: role
            column: id
        - id: to
          type: string
          references:
            relation: role
            column: id
      key: [from, to]
    - id: ingredient
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: from
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
        - id: to
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
      key: [from, to]
    - id: seedRegion
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: region
          type: string
          references:
            relation: region
            column: id
      key: [region]
    - id: stipulatedSeed
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
          references:
            relation: firm
            column: id
        - id: product
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: catalogComparison
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: firstProduct
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
        - id: secondProduct
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: traceComparison
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: firstSeed
          type: string
          references:
            relation: stipulatedSeed
            column: id
        - id: secondSeed
          type: string
          references:
            relation: stipulatedSeed
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: hypothesis
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: product
          type: string
          references:
            relation: product
            column: id
        - id: role
          type: string
          references:
            relation: role
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: requireHypothesis
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: hypothesis
          type: string
          references:
            relation: hypothesis
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: forbidHypothesis
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: hypothesis
          type: string
          references:
            relation: hypothesis
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: active
      source: assignment
      columns:
        - id: hypothesis
          type: string
          references:
            relation: hypothesis
            column: id
      key: [hypothesis]
      label: Product and role explanations
    - id: recallForward
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
        - id: product
          type: string
      key: [source, firm, product]
      label: Downstream tracing from each recall
    - id: recallSeedFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [source, firm]
    - id: recallDownstreamFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [source, firm]
      label: Downstream firms for each recall
    - id: catalogIntersection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: comparison
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [comparison, firm]
      label: Firms handling both compared products
    - id: traceIntersection
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: comparison
          type: string
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [comparison, firm]
      label: Firms downstream of both compared recalls
    - id: seed
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
        - id: product
          type: string
      key: [firm, product]
      label: Inquiry starting points
    - id: flow
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: fromFirm
          type: string
        - id: fromProduct
          type: string
        - id: toFirm
          type: string
        - id: toProduct
          type: string
      key: [fromFirm, fromProduct, toFirm, toProduct]
    - id: forward
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
        - id: product
          type: string
      key: [firm, product]
      label: Downstream product tracing
    - id: backward
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
        - id: product
          type: string
      key: [firm, product]
      label: Upstream product tracing
    - id: seedFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: inquiryFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
      label: Firms on the tracing inquiry list
    - id: downstreamFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: upstreamFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: directDownstreamFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: traceUnionFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: traceUnionState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
      key: [state]
    - id: regionalTraceFirm
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: firm
          type: string
      key: [firm]
    - id: inquiryState
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
      key: [state]
    - id: summaryCounts
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: inquiryFirms
          type: number
        - id: inquiryStates
          type: number
        - id: traceUnionFirms
          type: number
        - id: traceUnionStates
          type: number
      key: [inquiryFirms, inquiryStates, traceUnionFirms, traceUnionStates]
  generation:
    - id: GENERATE.HYPOTHESES
      relation: active
      from:
        relation: hypothesis
        column: id
      min:
        parameter: minActiveHypotheses
      max:
        parameter: maxActiveHypotheses
  rules:
    - id: RECALL.SOURCE.FORWARD
      head:
        relation: recallForward
        args: ["?source", "?firm", "?product"]
      body:
        - op: eq
          args:
            - parameter: seedMode
            - stipulated
        - relation: stipulatedSeed
          args: ["?source", "?firm", "?product"]
    - id: RECALL.SOURCE.CLOSURE
      head:
        relation: recallForward
        args: ["?source", "?b", "?q"]
      body:
        - relation: recallForward
          args: ["?source", "?a", "?p"]
        - relation: flow
          args: ["?a", "?p", "?b", "?q"]
    - id: RECALL.SOURCE.SEED
      head:
        relation: recallSeedFirm
        args: ["?source", "?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: stipulatedSeed
          args: ["?source", "?firm", "?product"]
    - id: RECALL.SOURCE.DOWNSTREAM
      head:
        relation: recallDownstreamFirm
        args: ["?source", "?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: recallForward
          args: ["?source", "?firm", "?product"]
        - not:
            relation: recallSeedFirm
            args: ["?source", "?firm"]
    - id: INTERSECT.CATALOGS
      head:
        relation: catalogIntersection
        args: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: catalogComparison
          args: ["?comparison", "?first", "?second"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?firm", "?first"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?firm", "?second"]
    - id: INTERSECT.SOURCE.TRACES
      head:
        relation: traceIntersection
        args: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: traceComparison
          args: ["?comparison", "?first", "?second"]
        - relation: recallDownstreamFirm
          args: ["?first", "?firm"]
        - relation: recallDownstreamFirm
          args: ["?second", "?firm"]
    - id: SEED.STIPULATED
      head:
        relation: seed
        args: ["?firm", "?product"]
      body:
        - op: eq
          args:
            - parameter: seedMode
            - stipulated
        - relation: stipulatedSeed
          args: ["?seed", "?firm", "?product"]
    - id: SEED.ACTIVE
      head:
        relation: seed
        args: ["?firm", "?product"]
      body:
        - op: eq
          args:
            - parameter: seedMode
            - hypothesis
        - relation: active
          args: ["?hypothesis"]
        - relation: hypothesis
          args: ["?hypothesis", "?product", "?role"]
        - relation: firmRole
          args: ["?firm", "?role"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
        - relation: firm
          args: ["?firm", "?label", "?state"]
        - relation: state
          args: ["?state", "?region"]
        - relation: seedRegion
          args: ["?region"]
    - id: FLOW.COMPATIBLE
      head:
        relation: flow
        args: ["?a", "?product", "?b", "?product"]
      body:
        - relation: firmRole
          args: ["?a", "?fromRole"]
        - relation: firmRole
          args: ["?b", "?toRole"]
        - relation: roleFlow
          args: ["?fromRole", "?toRole"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?a", "?product"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?b", "?product"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?a", "?b"]
    - id: FLOW.INGREDIENT
      head:
        relation: flow
        args: ["?firm", "?fromProduct", "?firm", "?toProduct"]
      body:
        - relation: firmRole
          args: ["?firm", processor]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?firm", "?fromProduct"]
        - relation: catalog
          args: ["?firm", "?toProduct"]
        - relation: ingredient
          args: ["?fromProduct", "?toProduct"]
    - id: FORWARD.SEED
      head:
        relation: forward
        args: ["?firm", "?product"]
      body:
        - relation: seed
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
    - id: FORWARD.CLOSURE
      head:
        relation: forward
        args: ["?b", "?q"]
      body:
        - relation: forward
          args: ["?a", "?p"]
        - relation: flow
          args: ["?a", "?p", "?b", "?q"]
    - id: BACKWARD.SEED
      head:
        relation: backward
        args: ["?firm", "?product"]
      body:
        - relation: seed
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
    - id: BACKWARD.CLOSURE
      head:
        relation: backward
        args: ["?a", "?p"]
      body:
        - relation: backward
          args: ["?b", "?q"]
        - relation: flow
          args: ["?a", "?p", "?b", "?q"]
    - id: PROJECT.SEEDS
      head:
        relation: seedFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: seed
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
    - id: PROJECT.INQUIRY
      head:
        relation: inquiryFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: forward
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
    - id: PROJECT.DOWNSTREAM
      head:
        relation: downstreamFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: forward
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
        - not:
            relation: seedFirm
            args: ["?firm"]
    - id: PROJECT.UPSTREAM
      head:
        relation: upstreamFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: backward
          args: ["?firm", "?product"]
        - not:
            relation: seedFirm
            args: ["?firm"]
    - id: PROJECT.DIRECT
      head:
        relation: directDownstreamFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: seed
          args: ["?seed", "?product"]
        - relation: flow
          args: ["?seed", "?product", "?firm", "?product"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?seed", "?firm"]
        - not:
            relation: seedFirm
            args: ["?firm"]
    - id: UNION.DOWNSTREAM
      head:
        relation: traceUnionFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: downstreamFirm
          args: ["?firm"]
    - id: UNION.UPSTREAM
      head:
        relation: traceUnionFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: upstreamFirm
          args: ["?firm"]
    - id: GEOGRAPHY.TRACE.STATE
      head:
        relation: traceUnionState
        args: ["?state"]
      body:
        - relation: traceUnionFirm
          args: ["?firm"]
        - relation: firm
          args: ["?firm", "?label", "?state"]
    - id: GEOGRAPHY.REPORT.AFTER.TRACE
      head:
        relation: regionalTraceFirm
        args: ["?firm"]
      body:
        - relation: traceUnionFirm
          args: ["?firm"]
        - relation: firm
          args: ["?firm", "?label", "?state"]
        - relation: state
          args:
            - "?state"
            - parameter: reportRegion
    - id: GEOGRAPHY.INQUIRY.STATE
      head:
        relation: inquiryState
        args: ["?state"]
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args: ["?firm"]
        - relation: firm
          args: ["?firm", "?label", "?state"]
    - id: COUNTS.DISTINCT
      head:
        relation: summaryCounts
        args: ["?firms", "?states", "?unionFirms", "?unionStates"]
      body:
        - count:
            relation: inquiryFirm
            args: ["?firm"]
          as: "?firms"
        - count:
            relation: inquiryState
            args: ["?state"]
          as: "?states"
        - count:
            relation: traceUnionFirm
            args: ["?uFirm"]
          as: "?unionFirms"
        - count:
            relation: traceUnionState
            args: ["?uState"]
          as: "?unionStates"
  admission:
    - id: TRACE.COMPARISON.MODE
      label: Concurrent recall comparisons require stipulated-seed mode
      when:
        - relation: traceComparison
          args: ["?comparison", "?first", "?second"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args:
          - parameter: seedMode
          - stipulated
    - id: HYPOTHESIS.NONEMPTY
      label: Hypothesis mode requires nonempty active assignments
      when:
        - op: eq
          args:
            - parameter: seedMode
            - hypothesis
      assert:
        op: gte
        args:
          - parameter: minActiveHypotheses
          - 1
    - id: STIPULATED.NO.HYPOTHESES
      label: Stipulated seed mode does not generate incident hypotheses
      when:
        - op: eq
          args:
            - parameter: seedMode
            - stipulated
      assert:
        op: eq
        args:
          - parameter: maxActiveHypotheses
          - 0
    - id: QUERY.TARGET
      label: The requested firm is in the declared domain
      when:
        - count:
            relation: firm
            args:
              - parameter: targetFirm
              - "?label"
              - "?state"
          as: "?matches"
      assert:
        op: gt
        args: ["?matches", 0]
    - id: REPORT.REGION
      label: The requested reporting region is declared
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: region
          args:
            - parameter: reportRegion
  constraints:
    - id: EVIDENCE.REQUIRED
      label: Every stipulated required hypothesis is active
      when:
        - relation: requireHypothesis
          args: ["?id", "?hypothesis"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: active
          args: ["?hypothesis"]
    - id: EVIDENCE.FORBIDDEN
      label: Every stipulated forbidden hypothesis is absent
      when:
        - relation: forbidHypothesis
          args: ["?id", "?hypothesis"]
      assert:
        op: notExists
        atom:
          relation: active
          args: ["?hypothesis"]
  queries:
    - id: concurrent-catalog-intersections
      label: Firms handling both compared products
      kind: set
      body:
        - relation: catalogIntersection
          args: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
      select: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
    - id: concurrent-trace-intersections
      label: Firms reached by both compared recalls
      kind: set
      body:
        - relation: traceIntersection
          args: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
      select: ["?comparison", "?firm"]
    - id: target-in-inquiry
      label: Inquiry membership for the selected firm
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args:
            - parameter: targetFirm
    - id: active-hypotheses
      label: Product and role explanation
      kind: set
      body:
        - relation: active
          args: ["?hypothesis"]
      select: ["?hypothesis"]
    - id: inquiry-F11
      label: Inquiry membership for reference firm F11
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args: [F11]
    - id: inquiry-F09
      label: Inquiry membership for reference firm F09
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args: [F09]
    - id: inquiry-F01
      label: Inquiry membership for reference firm F01
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args: [F01]
    - id: inquiry-F12
      label: Inquiry membership for reference firm F12
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: inquiryFirm
          args: [F12]
  reports:
    tables:
      - id: recall-forward
        label: Products traced from each recall starting point
        relation: recallForward
        columns: [source, firm, product]
      - id: recall-downstream
        label: Downstream firms for each recall
        relation: recallDownstreamFirm
        columns: [source, firm]
      - id: catalog-intersections
        label: Firms handling both compared products
        relation: catalogIntersection
        columns: [comparison, firm]
      - id: trace-intersections
        label: Firms downstream of both compared recalls
        relation: traceIntersection
        columns: [comparison, firm]
      - id: active
        label: Product and business-role explanation
        relation: active
        columns: [hypothesis]
      - id: seeds
        label: Where this inquiry starts
        relation: seed
        columns: [firm, product]
      - id: forward
        label: All downstream firm and product steps
        relation: forward
        columns: [firm, product]
      - id: inquiry
        label: Firms on this tracing inquiry list
        relation: inquiryFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: backward
        label: All upstream firm and product steps
        relation: backward
        columns: [firm, product]
      - id: direct
        label: Firms one supply step downstream
        relation: directDownstreamFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: downstream
        label: All downstream firms
        relation: downstreamFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: upstream
        label: All upstream firms
        relation: upstreamFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: union
        label: Distinct upstream and downstream firms
        relation: traceUnionFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: states
        label: States in the combined trace
        relation: traceUnionState
        columns: [state]
      - id: regional
        label: Traced firms in the selected reporting region
        relation: regionalTraceFirm
        columns: [firm]
      - id: counts
        label: Distinct firm and state totals
        relation: summaryCounts
        columns: [inquiryFirms, inquiryStates, traceUnionFirms, traceUnionStates]
  presentation:
    description: "Review {{parameter.targetFirm}} for inclusion in the tracing inquiry. Compare the explanations consistent with the supplied evidence and catalog, inspect where each explanation leads, and see which firms’ inclusion remains uncertain."
    question: "Is {{parameter.targetFirm}} included in this tracing inquiry?"
    labels:
      scenario: Possible incident explanation
      scenarios: Possible incident explanations
      assignment: Product and business-role explanation
      answer: Inquiry finding
      examples: Explanations behind these answers
    entities:
      - id: firm
        relation: firm
        key: id
        label: label
      - id: product
        relation: product
        key: id
        label: label
      - id: role
        relation: role
        key: id
        template: "{{row.id}}"
      - id: hypothesis
        relation: hypothesis
        key: id
        template: "{{row.product}} / {{row.role}}"
      - id: recall
        relation: stipulatedSeed
        key: id
        template: "{{row.firm}} / {{row.product}}"
      - id: catalog-comparison
        relation: catalogComparison
        key: id
        template: "{{row.firstProduct}} and {{row.secondProduct}}"
      - id: trace-comparison
        relation: traceComparison
        key: id
        template: "{{row.firstSeed}} and {{row.secondSeed}}"
    columns:
      - relation: firmRole
        column: firm
        label: Firm
        entity: firm
      - relation: firmRole
        column: role
        label: Business role
        entity: role
      - relation: catalog
        column: firm
        label: Firm
        entity: firm
      - relation: catalog
        column: product
        label: Product
        entity: product
      - relation: stipulatedSeed
        column: firm
        label: Firm
        entity: firm
      - relation: stipulatedSeed
        column: product
        label: Product
        entity: product
      - relation: catalogComparison
        column: firstProduct
        label: First product
        entity: product
      - relation: catalogComparison
        column: secondProduct
        label: Second product
        entity: product
      - relation: traceComparison
        column: firstSeed
        label: First recall
        entity: recall

definitionContract.title: Establish the required answer
definitionContract.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

module.title: Review food-traceability evidence

domain.label: Food supply chains
domain.description: Food production and distribution networks and their tracing relationships.

useCase.label: Identify firms for a tracing inquiry
useCase.description: Determine which firms belong on an inquiry list across permitted product and business-role explanations.

module.description: Review which firms belong on a tracing inquiry list before deciding whom to investigate. Compare the product and business-role explanations permitted by the case, derive possible supply connections, and follow each product through the network. Explicitly supplied recall starting points can also be traced and compared. Catalog compatibility supports a modeled inquiry; it does not establish contamination, actual shipments or an issued recall.
module.question: Which firms belong on this tracing inquiry list, and whose inclusion is still uncertain?
module.boundary: The conclusions cover the submitted firm directory, catalogs, business roles, product transformations, permitted incident explanations and tracing assumptions. A potential supply connection is not an observed shipment or contamination finding. Seed geography limits inquiry starting points; report geography filters the completed trace. Unlisted firms, products, lots, intermediaries and catalog errors are outside the declared model. Inquiry findings do not issue a recall or authorize other action.
assumptions: Each possible incident explanation uses an active set of product and business-role hypotheses permitted by the case. The reviewer does not choose which explanation is true.
The minimum and maximum numbers of active hypotheses are analytical premises supplied by the case.
Potential supply connections preserve product identity between distinct firms with compatible roles and matching catalogs.
A declared ingredient transformation changes products only within a processor handling both products.
Tracing retains firm–product identity and each stipulated recall origin. Reporting geography is applied after tracing and does not remove intermediate firms.
The derived inquiry list includes starting firms. Upstream and downstream reports exclude their own starting firms and count each firm or state once.
Counts and catalog overlap supply no probability of contamination or permission to act.

tableGroups.title: Product and role explanation

tableGroups.title: Firms to consider under this explanation

tableGroups.title: Each recall and their overlap
tableGroups.description: Keep each stipulated recall origin and its product-specific downstream trace separate before comparing the results.

tableGroups.title: Catalog overlap
tableGroups.description: Handling both products is a different question from being downstream of both recall starting points.

tableGroups.title: Downstream tracing
tableGroups.description: Follow outgoing product-specific potential connections. Downstream firm lists exclude the inquiry starting firms.

tableGroups.title: Upstream tracing
tableGroups.description: Follow the same potential connections backward. Upstream firm lists exclude the inquiry starting firms.

tableGroups.title: Combined trace and regional summary
tableGroups.description: Combine distinct upstream and downstream firms before counting states or filtering the reporting region.
